signin.privacy_title: What we keep when you sign in
signin.privacy_body: We keep your UAE PASS identifier, your assurance level, your profile type, the result of the match with the DET licence record and the time of sign-in. Your Emirates ID number is not stored. Your display name is used on screen only. Sign-in records are kept for a configurable period (illustrative: 24 months, personal fields removed at 12 months), to be confirmed with DET and counsel. Contact DET support to exercise your rights.

entry.signin_lead: AI-assisted tax, audit and compliance services for your Dubai trade licence.
entry.signin_demo: Presenting this service? The guided demo tells the story chapter by chapter.
entry.privacy_once: We show this once. You can read it again at any time from the Privacy notice link at the foot of every page.
entry.a11y_intro: We design this service so that everyone can use it, in Arabic and in English, on a computer or a phone.
entry.a11y_standard: WCAG 2.2 AA (assumed DET standard until DET states otherwise).
entry.a11y_keyboard: Every control works with a keyboard and shows a clear focus outline.
entry.a11y_targets: Buttons and links have touch targets of at least 44 px.
entry.a11y_contrast: Text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
entry.a11y_rtl: Arabic pages mirror correctly from right to left.
entry.a11y_motion: Animation is reduced when your device asks for reduced motion.
entry.a11y_contact: If something does not work for you, contact DET support and tell us which page and what happened.
entry.verify_lead: Check the status of a document issued through Smart Licence Services.
entry.verify_note: This page shows the status of a document issued through Smart Licence Services. It never shows amounts or company financial details.
